newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Sept housing finance rises 5.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Sept housing finance rises 5.8 pct.

text.p: Finance commitments for owner-occupied housing in Australia rose 5.8 percent by volume to 42,472 dwellings in September, seasonally-adjusted, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
In value terms, housing finance rose to A$4.13 billion in September from A$3.98 billion in August, the bureau said.
The Bureau said finance commitments for the construction of new dwellings rose 2.4 percent, in seasonally adjusted terms, to 5,057.
The number of dwellings refinanced rose to 11,856 from 11,139 in August.
The Bureau said financing by banks rose 7.0 percent in September, while financing by building societies rose 1.3 percent and other lenders fell 1.1 percent.
It said the increase in dwelling commitments in September was mainly attributable to a 6.1 percent rise in the purchase of established dwelling. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
